name: Quantum systems, Entanglement and Communication
description:
Quantization of light, quantum fluctuations, density matrix representation of quantum states, quantum
coherence and photon statistics, quantum superposition, EPR paradox, entanglement, no-cloning theorem,
quantum key distribution (QKD), quantum gates, and quantum teleportation.
